label: runsheet.dev/provisioning-request
note: The platform puts a tenant's whole label set: the PUT replaces it, so a redelivery or a replay converges, and an empty object clears it. The tenant goes by its ref when the platform holds one and by slug otherwise (ADR 047). The label runsheet.dev/provisioning-request (latchkey.ProvisioningRequestLabel) carries the id of the provisioning request whose plan and yes made the tenant. The GET answers the set as it is stored.

refusals.platform: an *OrgError: the reaction errors and retries, the tenant is made first

body.error: labels must be an object of strings

refusals.platform: an *OrgError that is Refused(): the reaction parks
